claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Nifekalant is a class III antiarrhythmic that selectively blocks hERG (KCNH2) potassium channels with an IC50 of ~8 uM, so at 2.5 uM it is expected to produce little or no cytotoxicity in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
